title: Every projection folds exactly the bytes whose integrity it established
note: D-2026-70. Each mutation restores one second read -- the verify-then-read window -- at one of the sites it was closed at, or disables the rule that hands back only the verified prefix. The suite opens the window deliberately: after the FIRST read returns, a self-consistent record with a broken chain link is appended, and every record a reducer receives is compared, byte for byte, against the snapshot the verification pass read. governed_stage10's own site is covered by G_R1 in stage10_authority.json.

mutations.rationale: the projection verifies one read and folds another: a record appended between the two is folded with its chain link unchecked
